subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Asset Recovery After Crime
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Asset Recovery After Crime.

hook.text: Catching the criminal is step one. Getting the money back? That's the real challenge.

buildup.text: Asset recovery involves tracing, freezing, and confiscating the proceeds of financial crime across borders.

discovery.text: The Stolen Asset Recovery Initiative helps developing countries reclaim funds looted by corrupt leaders.

twist.text: Recovery rates are tiny. Legal battles span years and cross dozens of jurisdictions.

climax.text: Without effective recovery, financial crime pays. The punishment must include losing the proceeds.

punchline.text: Catch the thief. Finding the money takes years longer.

quiz.question: Why is asset recovery so difficult?
options: Legal battles span years across many jurisdictions
